question: Who was recently appointed as a Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in June 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaminathan Janakiraman**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swaminathan Janakiraman** was appointed as a Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in June 2023.
 
• He succeeds Mahesh Kumar Jain, whose term ended in June 2023.
 
• Swaminathan Janakiraman has a significant experience in the banking sector and has held various key positions prior to this appointment.
 
• The Deputy Governor of the RBI plays a crucial role in formulating monetary policies and overseeing the financial stability of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is the central bank of India, responsible for regulating the issue and supply of the Indian rupee and managing the country's main payment systems.
 
• The RBI was established on April 1, 1935, in accordance with the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• The central bank's main functions include monetary policy regulation, financial supervision, and maintaining financial stability.
 
• The RBI is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• The RBI has four Deputy Governors, each overseeing different functions within the bank.
